description: This Swift source file defines the DockIconManager class, responsible for managing the visibility of the application's dock icon based on window visibility and user preferences. It observes window state changes and user defaults to dynamically update the dock icon activation policy.

classes.name: DockIconManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages whether the application's Dock icon is visible, depending on window states and user preferences.

methods.name: updateDockVisibility
methods.description: Updates the Dock icon visibility based on current window states and user settings.

methods.name: temporarilyShowDock
methods.description: Temporarily sets the app's activation policy to show the Dock icon.

methods.name: setupObservers
methods.description: Sets up observers for window changes and user defaults to trigger visibility updates.

methods.name: windowVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handler called when window visibility changes; triggers a visibility update.

methods.name: dockPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Handler called when user default preferences change; updates dock icon visibility accordingly.
